sources.title: Cinematic Style LoRA + Detail Enhancer for MiniMax H3
sources.snippet: Cinematic Style V2 for MiniMax H3 Cinema V2 is a major expansion of my broad cinematic style LoRA for MiniMax H3. The dataset now contains 1,852 cinematic images with 1,852 matching detailed captions — 3,704 files in total. Version 1 already provided a strong general foundation for realistic film photography, framing, lighting, lens character, depth of field, production design, atmosphere ...

sources.title: I2VA - MiniMax H3 Turbo + LoRA | TensorHub Art
sources.snippet: An optimized Image-to-Video (I2VA) generation tool powered by the MiniMax H3 Turbo framework. This tool gives you enhanced flexibility by allowing you to stack 1 Turbo model with up to 3 additional LoRAs simply by inputting their specific ID numbers.
